metadata.description: xOS Marketplace — Cross-cutting AI engines usable by any xOS instance (xHumanOS, xTeamOS, xCommunityOS, xFamilyOS). Install individual engines as @xos/<engine> or get them bundled in your platform (e.g., xHumanOS includes Career Intelligence which bundles brand-intelligence + social-distribution).

plugins.name: co-dialectic
plugins.description: Co-Dialectic v4.7.0 — LLM prompt optimizer + onboarding skill + compaction immunity + semantic T3 classification + fish-swarm + Protocol 0 post-compaction re-init. Cross-family judge-panel, hallucination detector, session handoff. Works with any LLM runtime.

plugins.name: brand-intelligence
plugins.description: Brand Intelligence — Persona schema, extraction, and registry. N-voice support for individuals (xHumanOS, N=1) and orgs (xTeamOS, N≥3). Includes persona-onboarding interview, handles, channel directory. Currently bundled in career-os-plugin; standalone extraction in progress.

plugins.name: social-distribution
plugins.description: Social Distribution — 9-gate preflight CI for content campaigns. Hub-spoke flywheel, golden-hour scheduling, invisible signal CTAs (bookmark/save/DM-share), platform-native routing. Currently bundled in career-os-plugin; standalone extraction in progress.

plugins.name: knowledge-graph
plugins.description: Knowledge Graph — Graph data layer for all xOS engines. Phase 1: JSON files. Phase 2: Neo4j substrate replacing all engine file stores. Individual career graphs (xHumanOS) and institutional knowledge graphs (xTeamOS). In design.

plugins.name: content-adapt
plugins.description: Content Adapt — Transform engine. One idea → platform-native variants (xHumanOS) or audience-specific variants (xTeamOS). Reads Brand Intelligence personas; outputs campaign components for Social Distribution. In design.
